text:
Maria (AE): Heads up — QuantumBridge sent an RFP this morning, they want a capability matrix + RFI answers and a POC plan. Asking for SOC2, data residency in EU, and a recommended POC config.
Devin (Solutions Eng): Can you drop the RFP doc here? need to confirm model types + input sizes.
Maria (AE): Attached the doc from their procurement (see link). Key asks: 1) feature matrix vs vendor list, 2) security questionnaire (they attached an 80‑q doc), 3) POC timeline (2–3 weeks preferred), 4) pricing for a pilot (monthly). Link: https://drive.internal/qb-rfp-2026.pdf
Sam (Sales Eng): Quick read — they want embedding + chat + a rerank endpoint. For POC we can propose Hosted API + Dedicated reserve for throughput. Rough commercial: small pilot with 4 reserved GPUs (~A10G equiv) + hosted burst = ~$11k/mo (commit), estimated token cost on top.
Devin (Solutions Eng): For the security Q: they specifically asked about KMS/HSM for key custody and separation of customer data. We should offer Private (VPC) + bring-your-KMS for the PII flow. That adds ops time but satisfies EU residency.
Olivia (Legal): I skimmed the questionnaire — they want standard DPA + processor/subprocessor list and an indemnity clause around model outputs. We can provide our SOC2 attestation and template DPA, but the indemnity language may need negotiation.
Jia (Customer Success): For POC success metrics, propose latency targets (<150ms tail at 512 tokens), availability 99.9% for the reserved pool, and a sample prompt set for quality evals. I'll own the eval harness.
Maria (AE): Devin/Sam — can you prepare a capability matrix row for: streaming, function-calling, embeddings, custom model pinning, quantized variants, fallback routing. Need it by EOD so AE can package.
Devin (Solutions Eng): Will do. I'll create a CSV with boolean + short notes. Example rows: "Streaming: yes (server-side streaming + SDK)"; "Function-calling: yes (structured outputs)".
Sam (Sales Eng): On pricing I'll add two options: 1) pilot commit 1 month refundable credit if they convert to Dedicated annual, 2) pure pay-as-you-go hosted with a token surcharge. Put numbers and assumptions in the spreadsheet.
Maria (AE): Procurement also asked about sample contract terms turnaround. Olivia — what's realistic for initial DPA + SOW?
Olivia (Legal): We can push DPA + standard SOW in 3 business days. Any bespoke IP/data clauses will take more — estimate 2–3 weeks if their counsel edits heavily.
Devin (Solutions Eng): Technical note for POC infra: recommend VPC Private with 2 dedicated nodes for caching + one small host for control plane (no customer data stored on control plane). Provide a small `docker-compose` snippet for on-prem connector if they want air-gapped ingestion.
Maria (AE): Can you paste that snippet here when ready, Devin? I'll include it in the answers doc.
Devin (Solutions Eng): Paste: ```
# on-prem ingestion connector (example)
version: '3'
services:
  ingest:
    image: redwood/ingest:latest
    env:
      - REDWOOD_ENDPOINT=https://private.example
      - KMS_KEY=arn:aws:kms:eu:123:key/abc
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
```
Sam (Sales Eng): Also flagging an enterprise blocker: QuantumBridge requires HSM-backed key rotation logs. We support KMS integrations but HSM audit hooks need a small integration ticket. Should we budget an integration SOW?
Olivia (Legal): Let's avoid committing to custom HSM work in the RFP response. Offer it as an add-on SOW and state timelines.
Maria (AE): Action items we agreed: Devin — capability matrix CSV + docker snippet. Sam — pricing sheet with two commercial options and a rough POC SOW (timeline + credits). Olivia — DPA + SOW template and note on indemnity. Jia — eval metrics + sample prompts. I'll assemble and send back to customer by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment redwood-console-v2 to prod succeeded (sha: b7f3c1) :rocket:
Jia (Customer Success): I'll draft the prompt set and share examples in a short spreadsheet.
Maria (AE): Thanks team — if anyone runs into blocking questions ping me directly. Will attach final files to procurement email. :pray:
